40021619.author: पदार्थः
40021619.content: सः He, विसृज्य having dismissed, ततः then, रामः Rama, पुष्पकम् the Pushpaka (chariot), हेमभूषितम् adorned with gold, प्रविवेश entered, महाबाहुः the mighty-armed one, अशोकवनिकाम् the Ashoka grove, तदा at that time.

40021619.author: Translation
40021619.content: Then, the mighty-armed Rama, having dismissed the gold-adorned Pushpaka chariot, entered the Ashoka grove.

40021620.author: पदार्थः
40021620.content: चन्दन sandalwood trees, अगरु aloe wood trees, चूतैः mango trees, च and, तुङ्गकालेयकैः tall Kāleyaka trees, अपि also, देवदारुवनैः forests of Deodar trees, च and, अपि also, समन्तात् all around, उपशोभिताम् adorned.

40021620.author: Translation
40021620.content: The grove was beautified all around by sandalwood, aloe wood, and mango trees, as well as tall Kāleyaka trees and forests of Deodar.

40021621.author: पदार्थः
40021621.content: चम्पक Champaka trees, अशोक Ashoka trees, पुन्नाग Punnaga trees, मधूक Madhuka trees, पनस Jackfruit trees, आसनैः Asana trees, शोभिताम् adorned, पारिजातैः by Parijata trees, च and, विधूमज्वलनप्रभैः shining like smokeless fire.

40021621.author: Translation
40021621.content: It was adorned with Champaka, Ashoka, Punnaga, Madhuka, Jackfruit, and Asana trees, and by Parijata trees that shone like smokeless flames.

40021622.author: पदार्थः
40021622.content: लोध्र Lodhra trees, नीप Nipa trees, अर्जुनैः Arjuna trees, नागैः Naga trees, सप्तपर्ण Saptaparna trees, अतिमुक्तकैः Atimuktaka creepers, मन्दार Mandara trees, कदली banana plants, गुल्म bushes, लताजाल networks of creepers, समावृताम् covered.

40021622.author: Translation
40021622.content: The grove was covered with Lodhra, Nipa, Arjuna, Naga, and Saptaparna trees, Atimuktaka creepers, Mandara trees, banana plants, and dense networks of bushes and vines.

40021623.author: पदार्थः
40021623.content: प्रियङ्गुभिः by Priyangu trees, कदम्बैः by Kadamba trees, च and, तथा similarly, च and, वकुलैः by Bakula trees, अपि also, जम्बूभिः by Jambu trees, दाडिमैः by Pomegranate trees, च and, एव indeed, कोविदारैः by Kovidara trees, च and, शोभिताम् adorned.

40021623.author: Translation
40021623.content: It was further adorned by Priyangu, Kadamba, Bakula, Jambu, Pomegranate, and Kovidara trees.

40021624.author: पदार्थः
40021624.content: सर्वदा always, कुसुमैः with flowers, रम्यैः beautiful, फलवद्भिः bearing fruit, मनोरमैः charming, दिव्यगन्धरसोपेतैः endowed with divine fragrance and taste, तरुणाङ्कुरपल्लवैः with young sprouts and tender leaves

40021624.author: Translation
40021624.content: The description refers to trees that are always adorned with beautiful flowers, charming fruit, and young sprouts and tender leaves, all possessing divine fragrance and taste.

40021625.author: पदार्थः
40021625.content: तथैव similarly, तरुभिः by trees, दिव्यैः divine, शिल्पिभिः by artisans, परिकल्पितैः arranged, चारुपल्लवपुष्पाढ्यैः rich with beautiful sprouts and flowers, मत्तभ्रमरसङ्कुलैः crowded with intoxicated bees

40021625.author: Translation
40021625.content: The trees, appearing as if divinely crafted by artisans, were similarly splendid, abundant with beautiful sprouts and flowers, and teeming with intoxicated bees.

40021626.author: पदार्थः
40021626.content: कोकिलैः by cuckoos, भृङ्गराजैः by king-bees, च and, नानावर्णैः of various colors, च and, पक्षिभिः by birds, शोभिताम् adorned, शतशः by hundreds, चित्राम् variegated, चूतवृक्षावतंसकैः with mango trees as prominent features

40021626.author: Translation
40021626.content: The place was adorned and made variegated by hundreds of cuckoos, king-bees, and birds of various colors, with mango trees serving as its prominent features.

40021627.author: पदार्थः
40021627.content: शातकुम्भनिभाः resembling refined gold, केचित् some, केचित् some, अग्निशिखोपमाः resembling flames of fire, नीलाञ्जननिभाः resembling blue collyrium, च and, अन्ये others, भान्ति shine, तत्रत्यपादपाः the trees there

40021627.author: Translation
40021627.content: The trees in that place shone with various hues, some resembling refined gold, others like flames of fire, and still others like blue collyrium.

40021628.author: पदार्थः
40021628.content: सुरभीणि fragrant, च and, पुष्पाणि flowers, माल्यानि garlands, विविधानि various, च and, दीर्घिकाः long ponds, विविधाकाराः of various shapes, पूर्णाः full, परमवारिणा with excellent water

40021628.author: Translation
40021628.content: There were fragrant flowers and various garlands, along with long ponds of diverse shapes filled with excellent water.

40021629.author: पदार्थः
40021629.content: माणिक्यकृतसोपानाः with steps made of rubies, स्फाटिकान्तरकुट्टिमाः with inner floors paved with crystal, फुल्लपद्मोत्पलवनाः with groves of blooming lotuses and water lilies, चक्रवाकोपशोभिताः adorned by chakravaka birds.

40021629.author: Translation
40021629.content: The place featured steps crafted from rubies, inner floors paved with crystal, abundant groves of blooming lotuses and water lilies, and was graced by the presence of chakravaka birds.

40021630.author: पदार्थः
40021630.content: दात्यूहशुकसङ्घुष्टा resonant with the calls of gallinules and parrots, हंससारसनादिताः made to resound by swans and cranes, तरुभिः by trees, पुष्पवद्भिश्च and full of flowers, तीरजैः growing on the banks, उपशोभिताः adorned.

40021630.author: Translation
40021630.content: It was filled with the sounds of gallinules, parrots, swans, and cranes, and beautifully adorned by flowering trees growing along its banks.

40021631.author: पदार्थः
40021631.content: प्राकारैः by enclosures, विविधाकारैः of various forms, शोभिताश्च and adorned, शिलातलैः by rock surfaces, तत्रैव there indeed, च and, वनोद्देशे in that part of the forest, वैडूर्यमणिसन्निभैः resembling lapis lazuli gems.

40021631.author: Translation
40021631.content: The area was embellished with diverse enclosures and rock surfaces, and within that forest region, there were spots that shimmered like lapis lazuli gems.

40021632.author: पदार्थः
40021632.content: शाद्वलैः by green meadows, परमोपेतां supremely endowed, पुष्पितद्रुमकाननाम् with groves of flowering trees, तत्र there, सङ्घर्षजातानां grown from close proximity, वृक्षाणां of trees, पुष्पशालिनाम् adorned with flowers.

40021632.author: Translation
40021632.content: It was supremely rich with green meadows and flowering tree groves, where trees growing in close proximity were resplendent with blossoms.

40021633.author: पदार्थः
40021633.content: प्रस्तराः the rock surfaces, पुष्पशबला variegated with flowers, नभः the sky, तारागणैः by clusters of stars, इव as if, नन्दनं Nandana, हि indeed, यथा just as, इन्द्रस्य of Indra, ब्राह्मं of Brahma, चैत्ररथं Chaitraratha, यथा just as, तथाभूतं such, हि indeed, रामस्य of Rama, काननं the garden, सन्निवेशनाम् the dwelling/setting.

40021633.author: Translation
40021633.content: The rock surfaces were variegated with flowers, resembling the sky adorned with clusters of stars, and indeed, Rama's garden and dwelling were as magnificent as Indra's Nandana or Kubera's Chaitraratha.

40021634.author: पदार्थः
40021634.content: तथाभूतं such, हि indeed, रामस्य of Rama, काननं garden, सन्निवेशनम् dwelling, बह्वासनगृहोपेतां endowed with many seats and houses, लतागृहसमावृताम् surrounded by creeper-houses.

40021634.author: Translation
40021634.content: Indeed, such was Rama's dwelling garden, adorned with numerous seats and pavilions, and enveloped by charming creeper-houses.

40021635.author: पदार्थः
40021635.content: अशोकवनिकां into the Ashoka grove, स्फीतां extensive, प्रविश्य having entered, रघुनन्दनः Rama, the delight of the Raghus, आसने on a seat, च and, शुभाकारे of beautiful form, पुष्पप्रकरभूषिते adorned with heaps of flowers.

40021635.author: Translation
40021635.content: Having entered the extensive Ashoka grove, Rama, the delight of the Raghus, found a beautifully shaped seat adorned with heaps of flowers.

40021636.author: पदार्थः
40021636.content: कुशास्तरणसंस्तीर्णे spread with a mat of Kusa grass, रामः Rama, सन्निषसाद sat down, ह indeed, सीतामादायं taking Sita, हस्तेन by the hand, मधुमैरेयकं the wine called Madhu-Maireyaka, शुचि pure.

40021636.author: Translation
40021636.content: Rama indeed sat down on the seat, which was spread with a mat of Kusa grass, and with Sita by his hand, he had the pure Madhu-Maireyaka wine ready.

40021637.author: पदार्थः
40021637.content: पाययामास made to drink, काकुत्स्थः Rama, शचीमिव like Shachi, पुरन्दरः Indra, मांसानि meats, च and, समृष्टानि well-prepared, फलानि fruits, विविधानि various, च and.

40021637.author: Translation
40021637.content: Rama, the descendant of Kakutstha, made her drink, just as Indra makes Shachi drink, and there were well-prepared meats and various fruits.

40021638.author: पदार्थः
40021638.content: रामस्याभ्यवहारार्थं for Rama's meal, किङ्कराः servants, तूर्णम् quickly, आहरन् brought, उपानृत्यंश्च and danced before, राजानं the king, नृत्यगीतविशारदाः skilled in dance and song.

40021638.author: Translation
40021638.content: Servants quickly brought food for Rama's meal, and those skilled in dance and song performed before the king.

40021639.author: पदार्थः
40021639.content: बालाः young, च and, रूपवत्यः beautiful, च and, स्त्रियः women, पानवशानुगाः subservient to drink, मनोभिरामाः charming, रामाः women, ताः those, रामः Rama, रमयतां among those who delight, वरः the best.

40021639.author: Translation
40021639.content: Rama, the best among those who delight, was in the company of young, beautiful, and charming women who were under the influence of drink.

40021640.author: पदार्थः
40021640.content: उपानृत्यन्त danced before, काकुत्स्थम् Kakutstha (Rama), नृत्यगीतविशारदाः skilled in dance and song, मनोभिरामाः charming, रामाः women, ताः those, रामः Rama, रमयतां among those who delight, वरः the best.

40021640.author: Translation
40021640.content: Skilled in dance and song, charming women danced before Rama, the best among those who delight.

40021641.author: पदार्थः
40021641.content: रमयामास he delighted, धर्मात्मा the righteous soul (Rama), नित्यम् always, परमभूषितः highly adorned, सः he, तया with her, सीतया Sita, सार्धम् together with, आसीनः seated, विरराज shone, ह indeed.

40021641.author: Translation
40021641.content: The righteous Rama, always highly adorned, delighted (them), and he shone splendidly while seated with Sita.

40021642.author: पदार्थः
40021642.content: अरुन्धत्या with Arundhati, सह with, आसीनः seated, वसिष्ठः Vasishtha, इव like, तेजसा with splendor, एवम् thus, रामः Rama, मुदा with joy, युक्तः endowed, सीताम् Sita, सुरसुतोपमाम् resembling a celestial nymph.

40021642.author: Translation
40021642.content: Rama, filled with joy, thus shone with splendor like Vasishtha seated with Arundhati, with Sita resembling a celestial nymph.

40021643.author: पदार्थः
40021643.content: रमयामास he delighted, वैदेहीम् Vaidehi (Sita), अहन्यहनि day after day, देववत् like a god, तथा thus, तयोः of those two, विहरतोः while sporting, सीताराघवयोः of Sita and Raghava, चिरम् for a long time.

40021643.author: Translation
40021643.content: Rama, like a god, delighted Sita day after day, and thus Sita and Raghava sported together for a long time.

40021644.author: पदार्थः
40021644.content: अत्यक्रामत् passed away, शुभः auspicious, कालः time, शैशिरः winter, भोगदः giving enjoyment, सदा always, प्राप्तयोः for the two who had obtained, विविधान् various, भोगान् enjoyments, अतीतः passed, शिशिरागमः winter season.

40021644.author: Translation
40021644.content: The auspicious and always pleasure-giving winter season, during which Rama and Sita had enjoyed various pleasures, passed away.

40021645.author: पदार्थः
40021645.content: पूर्वाह्णे in the forenoon, धर्मकार्याणि religious duties, कृत्वा having done, धर्मेण righteously, धर्मवित् the knower of dharma, शेषं the remaining, दिवसभागार्धम् half of the day's portion, अन्तःपुरगतः gone to the inner apartments, अभवत् became.

40021645.author: Translation
40021645.content: Having performed his religious duties righteously in the forenoon, the knower of dharma, Rama, spent the remaining half of the day in his inner apartments.

40021646.author: पदार्थः
40021646.content: सीतापि Sita also, देवकार्याणि divine duties, कृत्वा having done, पौर्वाह्णिकानि morning, वै indeed, श्वश्रूणाम् of the mothers-in-law, अकरोत् performed, पूजां reverence, सर्वासाम् of all, अविशेषतः without distinction.

40021646.author: Translation
40021646.content: Sita also, having performed her morning divine duties, reverently honored all her mothers-in-law without any distinction.

40021647.author: पदार्थः
40021647.content: अभ्यगच्छत् approached, ततः then, रामं Rama, विचित्राभरणाम्बरा adorned with various ornaments and garments, त्रिविष्टपे in heaven, सहस्राक्षम् the thousand-eyed one, उपविष्टं seated, यथा just as, शची Shachi.

40021647.author: Translation
40021647.content: Then, adorned with various ornaments and garments, Sita approached Rama, just as Shachi approaches the thousand-eyed Indra seated in heaven.

40021648.author: पदार्थः
40021648.content: दृष्ट्वा having seen, तु indeed, राघवः Rama, पत्नीं wife, कल्याणेन with auspiciousness, समन्विताम् endowed, प्रहर्षम् great joy, अतुलं incomparable, लेभे obtained, साधु excellent, साधु excellent, इति thus, च and, अब्रवीत् said.

40021648.author: Translation
40021648.content: Having seen his wife, Sita, endowed with auspiciousness, Rama felt incomparable joy and exclaimed, "Excellent, excellent!"

40021649.author: पदार्थः
40021649.content: अब्रवीत् said, च and, वरारोहां to the one with beautiful thighs, सीतां Sita, सुरसुतोपमाम् who was like a daughter of a god, अपत्यलाभः the gain of offspring, वैदेहि O Vaidehi, त्वयि in you, मे to me, समुपस्थितः has come.

40021649.author: Translation
40021649.content: Rama said to Sita, who had beautiful thighs and resembled a divine daughter, "O Vaidehi, the blessing of progeny has come to me through you."

40021650.author: पदार्थः
40021650.content: किम् what, इच्छसि do you desire, वरारोहे O one with beautiful thighs, कामः desire, किम् what, क्रियताम् may be done, तव for you, स्मितं smile, कृत्वा having made, तु indeed, वैदेही Vaidehi, रामं to Rama, वाक्यम् words, अथ then, अब्रवीत् said.

40021650.author: Translation
40021650.content: Rama asked Sita, "O one with beautiful thighs, what do you desire? What wish of yours may I fulfill?" Then, smiling, Vaidehi spoke these words to Rama.

40021651.author: पदार्थः
40021651.content: तपोवनानि hermitages, पुण्यानि sacred, द्रष्टुम् to see, इच्छामि I desire, राघव O Raghava, गङ्गातीरोपविष्टानाम् of those seated on the banks of the Ganga, ऋषीणाम् of the sages, उग्रतेजसाम् of fierce ascetic power.

40021651.author: Translation
40021651.content: Sita said, "O Raghava, I desire to see the sacred hermitages and the sages of fierce ascetic power seated on the banks of the Ganga."

40021652.author: पदार्थः
40021652.content: फलमूलाशिनाम् of those who subsist on fruits and roots, देव O Lord, पादमूलेषु at the feet, वर्तितुम् to dwell, एषः this, मे my, परमः greatest, कामः desire, यत् that, मूलफलभोजिनाम् of those who subsist on roots and fruits.

40021652.author: Translation
40021652.content: Sita continued, "O Lord, to dwell at the feet of those who subsist on fruits and roots—this is my greatest desire, that I may be among those who eat roots and fruits."

40021653.author: पदार्थः
40021653.content: अपि even, एकरात्रम् for one night, काकुत्स्थ O Kakutstha, निवसेयम् I may dwell, तपोवने in a hermitage, तथा so be it, इति thus, च and, प्रतिज्ञातम् was promised, रामेण by Rama, अक्लिष्टकर्मणा whose deeds are unwearied, विस्रब्धा confident, भव be, वैदेहि O Vaidehi, श्वः tomorrow, गमिष्यसि you will go, असंशयम् without doubt.

40021653.author: Translation
40021653.content: Sita expressed her desire to dwell in a hermitage for even one night, to which Rama, whose deeds were effortless, promised, "So be it, O Vaidehi, be confident, you will undoubtedly go tomorrow."

40021654.author: पदार्थः
40021654.content: एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, तु indeed, काकुत्स्थः Rama, मैथिलीम् to Maithili, जनकात्मजाम् Janaka's daughter, मध्यकक्षान्तरम् to the middle apartment, रामः Rama, निर्जगाम went out, सुहृद्वृतः surrounded by friends.

40021654.author: Translation
40021654.content: After speaking thus to Sita, Janaka's daughter, Rama, surrounded by his friends, went out to the middle apartment. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे द्विचत्वारिंशः सर्गः ।। 42 ।। Thus ends the forty-second sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
